notes.title: Shop Crush - A shop simulator and hacker horror based on Negative Space.
notes.content:
[b]Hey friends,[/b]

[h3][b]We are delighted to announce our second game, Shop Crush, as listed on Steam.[/b][/h3]

Shop Crush is a shop simulator and hacker horror game based on Negative Space. As you look for clients, strange things happen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6786636/510287a6aa204511c03984cbbb52283ded2b62a4.gif[/img]

Be it shady or fair, deal with client tastes and preferences in a choice-based game. But, each client has seek rates too high.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6786636/6e7adafae396aa58b5c4ccd8ea8e8fe8362ea141.png[/img]

You must make a profit to survive the business! Buy diverse and exotic products and sell them with a crazy margin. But beware: Dealing with suspicious clients might increase your sales, but it will also lower the shop's reputation. If either Income or Reputation is zero, the shop will be closed...

The game is in the active development stage and is expected to be released within the next six months. We are so happy with this game and would like to hear your feedback and opinions about it!

[previewyoutube=gX4_HCgDUUg;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Bsl Team[/i]

notes.title: ONE DAY for Ched 6 Years Anniversary - Grand 4K Ultra HD RESTART LEVEL Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6786636/8c339e5bd7b52e2517eab47f5f98f516981089c3.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]ONE DAY for Ched 6 Years Anniversary - Grand HD Update![/h3][/b]

[b]Here is what we achieved so far together, people:[/b]

[list]
[*] 1. Gained Trading cards and successfully share them with each other
[*] 2. Added Achievements and challenges
[*] 3. Made DLC and many other tweaks we are happy about.
[/list]

Now it's time to finally celebrate - and make our game last even more!
So we have added stuff you wanted more - ONE DAY for Ched now supports 4K Resolutions and FULL HD.
You can play it on your brand new smart TV or Ultra 4K Monitor - all with our new scalable launcher :)

We have also added an option to restart a level quickly - by pressing the R button.
